Web Manga 'Mii-chan to Yamada-san' Gets Anime Adaptation in 2027
Production company Kodansha announced an anime adaptation of Nene Azuki's Mii-chan to Yamada-san (Mii-chan and Miss Yamada) web manga on Sunday and revealed an illustration (pictured) drawn by Azuki to commemorate the announcement. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027. Azuki began serializing the drama manga on the Magazine pocket website in September 2024. Third Season of New 'Ranma ½' Anime Announces Additional Cast
The official website of the new Ranma ½ anime series revealed additional cast and a key visual (pictured) for its third season on Saturday. The anime series adapting Rumiko Takahashi's romantic comedy manga will premiere on Nippon Television at 12.55 a.m. on October 4. Toei Animation Produces New 'Ginga Tetsudou 999' Theatrical Anime Adaptation
Toei Animation announced a new theatrical anime adaptation for Ginga Tetsudou 999 (Galaxy Express 999) anime franchise on Saturday. The new film features a story concept by Rintarou (Ginga Tetsudou 999 (Movie), Sayonara Ginga Tetsudou 999 director) and animation production by Toei Animation. Ginga Tetsudou 999 (Galaxy Express 999), based on the sci-fi manga by Leiji Matsumoto, was serialized in Shounen King magazine from January 1977 to October 1981.
